# WebsiteToApp - Convert Any Website to Android App

> WebsiteToApp.app converts any website into a native Android APK in minutes. No coding required.

## What WebsiteToApp Does
- **Website to APK Converter**: Enter your website URL, get a ready-to-publish Android APK
- **No Coding Required**: Works with any website — WordPress, Shopify, Wix, React, HTML
- **Native Features**: Push notifications, biometric auth, offline mode, file upload, QR scanner
- **Play Store Ready**: Generates signed AAB/APK ready for Google Play Store submission
- **Customizable**: Custom app icon, splash screen, colors, navigation menu
- **Fast Build**: APK generated in under 5 minutes

## Supported Platforms
Convert websites built with: WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, GoDaddy, Blogger, Weebly, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, HTML, PHP, Laravel, Django, Flask, Bubble, Glide, FlutterFlow, Lovable, Bolt.new, v0.dev, Streamlit

## Features
- WebView with JavaScript bridge
- Push notifications (Firebase)
- Biometric authentication (fingerprint/face)
- File upload & download
- Camera & QR code scanner
- GPS/location services
- Custom user agent
- Screenshot prevention
- Offline mode (cache)
- AdMob integration
- Bottom navigation menu
- Pull-to-refresh
- External link handling
